content: Ethyl hydroxybenzoate, commonly known as ethylparaben (ethyl para-hydroxybenzoate), is the ethyl ester derivative of p-hydroxybenzoic acid. Its chemical formula is HO-C6H4-CO-O-CH2CH3. This compound belongs to the class of chemicals known as parabens. Ethylparaben is primarily utilized as an antifungal preservative. When used as a food additive, it is assigned the E number E214. Additionally, sodium ethyl para-hydroxybenzoate, which is the sodium salt form of ethylparaben, serves the same purposes and is designated with the E number E215.
